name: My Sweet Summer
source:
A visual novel about flirting, chance encounters, and those short moments that somehow stay with us the longest.
It’s a series of stories about a guy named Alex — a charming player with a quick smile, fast reactions, and a heart that’s not as simple as it seems. He’s not looking for love… but love tends to find him anyway.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3841480/]Steam[/url]]
